newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: IMF POSITIVE ON ECONOMIC POLICIES.
newsitem.headline: IMF POSITIVE ON ECONOMIC POLICIES.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is largely positive about the economic policies being pursued in Lithuania and a mission in the country is to decide on future cooperation, the Fund said on Tuesday.

The mission is assessing how Lithuania met the economic criteria of a $200 million extended fund facility (EFF) and its report will pave the way for a final disbursement of $15 million, said IMF Lithuania representative Domenico Fanizza.
"The mission is assessing the performance under the arrangement and discussing with the authorities about future cooperation," Fanizza told Reuters.
"The assessment of policies is positive. We are discussing with the authorities what to do next," he added.
He said that Lithuania did not need direct aid but may want to have the chance to get cash in a crisis under another EFF or a standby arrangement.
"There would be an understanding that they would not draw on the funds," Fanizza said but added that precise terms had not been fixed.
